title: "Meet my family?" Sag: books a flight.
caption: "Meet my family?" and the bag is already packed. Sagittarius had a one-way ticket ready before the text finished. When it gets serious and you feel the itch to run, say it out loud instead. You might hear "me too." Send this to your runaway.
